def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]

    # A full row/column of a non-background color marks the boundary.
    mr = next((r for r in range(h)
               if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]) and grid[r][0] != bg), None)
    mc = next((c for c in range(w)
               if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))
               and grid[0][c] != bg), None)

    if mr is not None:
        marker_color = grid[mr][0]
        pts = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] not in (bg, marker_color)]
        if not pts:
            return [row[:] for row in grid]
        lo, hi = min(r for r, c, v in pts), max(r for r, c, v in pts)
        line = lo - 1 if (lo + hi) / 2 > (h - 1) / 2 else hi + 1
        line = max(0, min(h - 1, line))
        marker_side = 1 if mr > line else -1
        obj_side = 1 if (lo + hi) / 2 > line else -1
        out = [row[:] for row in grid]
        for r, c, v in pts:
            out[r][c] = bg
        for r, c, v in pts:
            rr = 2 * line - r if obj_side != marker_side else r
            if 0 <= rr < h:
                out[rr][c] = v
        for c in range(w):
            out[line][c] = 8
        return out

    if mc is not None:
        marker_color = grid[0][mc]
        pts = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] not in (bg, marker_color)]
        if not pts:
            return [row[:] for row in grid]
        lo, hi = min(c for r, c, v in pts), max(c for r, c, v in pts)
        line = lo - 1 if (lo + hi) / 2 > (w - 1) / 2 else hi + 1
        line = max(0, min(w - 1, line))
        marker_side = 1 if mc > line else -1
        obj_side = 1 if (lo + hi) / 2 > line else -1
        out = [row[:] for row in grid]
        for r, c, v in pts:
            out[r][c] = bg
        for r, c, v in pts:
            cc = 2 * line - c if obj_side != marker_side else c
            if 0 <= cc < w:
                out[r][cc] = v
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][line] = 8
        return out

    return [row[:] for row in grid]
